theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (p R Λ ε : ℝ) (a : ℝ → ℝ), (n : ℝ) < p → 0 < R → 0 < Λ → 0 < ε → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → (1 + ε) * t < R → ContinuousAt a t ∧ |a t| ≤ 2 * ((p - n) / (4 * p)) * Λ / R * (t / R) ^ (-((n : ℝ) / p))) → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → (1 + ε) * t < R → ContinuousAt (fun u => ∫ τ in (0)..u, a τ) t ∧ |∫ τ in (0)..t, a τ| ≤ Λ / 2
